rationale: The candidate reads as a single elongated mass with a shared central court, so the dominant idea is understandable in all views. However, the form depends heavily on layered slab offsets and some stepped edge conditions rather than a stronger singular gesture. The overlapping pair is plausible, but the geometry feels somewhat clipped and mechanically repeated, which weakens hierarchy. The void is present but not yet emphatically public or spatially legible as an organizing undercut/courtyard. Overall it has decent precedent resonance with stacked/shifted OMA-like section logic and a modest BIG-style overlap, but it is still early and slightly over-fragmented.
warnings: The silhouette relies partly on stepbacks and layered slab edges.
Some volumes read as overlapping rather than cleanly integrated.
The central void is visible but not yet strongly public in massing terms.
The mass would benefit from a clearer anchor and fewer secondary surface cuts.
